title: Early domesticated cowpea (Vigna unguiculata) from central Ghana
lineage: Brief research notes paraphrase inspected passages; not a source copy.

passages.note: Charred cowpeas from Kintampo rock shelters in central Ghana date to the second millennium BCE. The authors interpret them as early domesticated cowpea. Only the accessible extract was read; the specific dating and trait methodology requires full-text review.
